In this section we show that
``quasi-affine morphisms satisfy descent for fpqc-coverings''.
Here is the formal statement.

Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme.
Let <MATH_0002> be an fpqc covering, see
Topologies, Definition <REF_0001>.
Let <MATH_0003> be a descent datum
relative to <MATH_0004>. If each morphism
<MATH_0005> is quasi-affine, then the descent datum is
effective.
